name: Teresh
overview: The biblical figure Teresh appears as one of the king's chamberlains who conspired against King Ahasuerus, as recorded in Esther 2:21-23 and Esther 6:2. Alongside Bigthan, Teresh sought to harm the king, but their plot was uncovered through Mordecai's vigilance and reported by Queen Esther. Their conspiracy was punished by execution, demonstrating God's providential protection over the king and the faithful role Mordecai played in preserving the kingdom.
